## 💡 Key Things to Look for When Choosing a Consultant

When evaluating these (or any) Power Apps partner for **warehouse, shop-floor, or field operations**, consider:

| Criteria | Why It Matters |
|---|---|
| **Microsoft Certified Partner status** | Ensures verified expertise and access to Microsoft support |
| **Dataverse architecture experience** | Critical for scalable, relational operational data |
| **Canvas App vs. Model-Driven App skills** | Canvas apps suit field/mobile use; model-driven apps suit case/job management |
| **Offline capability experience** | Essential for warehouse/shop-floor environments with poor connectivity |
| **Integration with ERP/WMS systems** | E.g., connecting to SAP, MYOB, Dynamics 365, or custom databases |
| **Local Brisbane presence** | Enables on-site workshops and faster collaboration |
